products.summary: The largest battery we found in a rugged phone sold to US buyers: 33,000 mAh, with 66 W charging and 18 W reverse charging, plus a 100-lumen projector and a 1,200-lumen camping light.
products.fit: Campers, field workers and anyone off-grid for days who wants one device that is phone, power bank, work light and movie projector, and who will carry it in a holster or bag.
caveats: Heavy and thick: 876.6 g (1.93 lb) and 35.6 mm. Every review we read calls it too big for a pocket.

Ships with Android 14, which is older than the WP63's Android 16.

notes:
QUERY CHOICE: OUKITEL's US store (oukitel.store, USD, phones and tablets ship from a US warehouse) sells rugged phones, rugged tablets and budget phones. It has no power stations. 'Rugged phone with biggest battery' is a real query. Today's results are mostly generic listicles (memeburn, rugone, joybuy, abramsartists-type spam) and a GSMArena-style database, so the field is thin. The WP100 Titan honestly wins on capacity: 33,000 mAh vs 25,500 (Ulefone Armor 34 Pro/Pro+), 23,800 (8849 Tank 3 Pro), 17,600 (8849 Tank 5). The only phone near it, the Energizer P30K Apex (30,000 mAh), is a Europe-only launch at €399 with no US release found. I also considered 'phone with built-in projector', but the Tank 5 (220 lm, 2K) wins that segment outright and isn't in any approved program, so I used it as a segment rival here.

PAIN POINTS (counts across reviews, listings and FAQs read): weight and bulk, 7 (TechRadar Titan; ZDNet via Notebookcheck; Unite4buy via Notebookcheck; Heise summary; Android Central Tank 3 Pro; TechRadar Tank 5; Notebookcheck Armor 34 Pro thickness). Low projector resolution or dim projection, 4 (TechRadar Titan 854×480; TechRadar Tank 5 comparison; Liliputing Tank 3 Pro 480p; Club386 headline). US carrier and band fit, 3 (Walmart seller listing 'except B71, just T-Mobile'; OUKITEL WP63 FAQ 'Verizon not recommended'; Kimovil checker exists but was unreadable). Slow chip, 1 (TechRadar Tank 5 review on the Dimensity 7300). Dim screen and average cameras, 1 (Unite4buy). Projector drains battery at 20-25%/h, 1 (Digital Camera World on Tank 4 Pro; not printed). Reddit r/oukitel_official was only reachable through a mirror with a bad cert, so I have no Reddit counts.

SEGMENT WINNERS: max capacity and power bank use goes to the WP100 Titan (33,000 mAh). Lighter and cheaper multi-day goes to the WP63 (20,000 mAh, 629 g, $339 pre-order); its rivals' current prices are unverified, so the page claims only that it is the lightest and cheapest of the five listed. That rests on the WP63's verified $339 and the rivals' launch prices ($570-$1,199), which come from reviews, not from today's stores. Best projector goes to the 8849 Tank 5 (220 lm 2K). Faster chip with a projector goes to the 8849 Tank 3 Pro (Dimensity 8200, 696 g).
